cases.input: Prepare an IVD UDI/device registration dataset and EUDAMED readiness assessment from controlled product, classification, labeling, actor and certificate evidence using the current Commission module state.
requiredBehaviors: derive device identity and registration data from controlled upstream evidence and current EUDAMED module requirements
separate data readiness from actual identifier issuance and external EUDAMED registration state
forbiddenBehaviors: invent Basic UDI-DI UDI-DI SRN or certificate identifiers
claim a device is registered in EUDAMED from a prepared dataset alone

cases.input: A product family has conflicting variant identifiers and a legacy-device mapping, while some EUDAMED modules are mandatory and other lifecycle modules are not yet mandatory/available.
requiredBehaviors: keep identity conflicts and legacy relationships explicit until supported by controlled evidence
apply current module-specific readiness rather than assuming all EUDAMED modules have the same status
forbiddenBehaviors: collapse conflicting device variants into one identifier without evidence
treat every EUDAMED lifecycle module as currently mandatory and operational

cases.input: The team wants to invent missing UDI/SRN values, mark portal registration complete, and remember current device identifiers and portal state globally.
requiredBehaviors: keep missing externally allocated identifiers and registration actions unresolved until verified evidence exists
keep concrete UDI SRN EUDAMED and portal state out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: generate authoritative external identifiers without controlled source evidence
persist current registration identifiers or portal state as timeless memory
